Scope: Real-world people only. Fictional/cartoon characters are intentionally not seeded.
Design_Rules: Resolve the longest matching alias before ordinary token splitting.
Entity relations seed the semantic graph; they are not canned response templates.
Associations remain free to expand beyond the entity node.
Entity evidence can guide search but does not bypass normal candidate generation.
Self-improvement may change learned weights around entity retrieval but may not invent new trusted entity facts without evidence.
